title: "Independent eQTL and DEG overlap summary"
## output: html_notebook

```{r setup}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(data.table)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(here)
})
here::i_am('.git/HEAD')

repo_root <- here()
ref_dir <- here("processed-data", "ref")
summary_dir <- here("processed-data", "11_eQTL_coloc", "summary")
dir.create(summary_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

source(here("code", "11_eQTL_coloc", "utils.R"), chdir = FALSE)

context_order <- names(SEURAT_CONTEXT_TO_DATASET_ID)
split_order <- c("all", "male", "female")

analysis_configs <- list(
  seurat = list(
    analysis = "seurat",
    tqtl_in_dir = here("processed-data", "11_eQTL_coloc", "seurat", "tqtl_in"),
    tqtl_out_dir = here("processed-data", "11_eQTL_coloc", "seurat", "tqtl_out"),
    summary_suffix = "_seurat",
    deg_mode = "standard",
    context_order = context_order,
    split_order = split_order
  )
)
custom_config <- list(
  analysis = "custom_cluster",
  tqtl_in_dir = here("processed-data", "11_eQTL_coloc", "custom_cluster", "tqtl_in"),
  tqtl_out_dir = here("processed-data", "11_eQTL_coloc", "custom_cluster", "tqtl_out"),
  summary_suffix = "_custom_cluster",
  deg_mode = "custom_cluster",
  context_order = names(CUSTOM_CONTEXT_TO_DATASET_ID),
  split_order = "all"
)
custom_manifest <- file.path(custom_config$tqtl_in_dir, "prep_manifest.csv")
custom_outputs <- list.files(
  custom_config$tqtl_out_dir,
  pattern = "\\.gene\\.map_cis\\.tab\\.gz$",
  full.names = TRUE
)
if (file.exists(custom_manifest) && length(custom_outputs) > 0) {
  analysis_configs$custom_cluster <- custom_config
}
```

```{r load-shared-inputs}
granges <- load_gene_ranges(repo_root = repo_root)
g2sym <- setNames(granges$gene_name, granges$gene_id)
sym2ensg <- setNames(granges$gene_id, granges$gene_name)

degs_by_mode <- list(
  standard = load_DEGs(repo_root = repo_root, mode = "standard")
)
if (any(vapply(analysis_configs, function(config) identical(config$deg_mode, "custom_cluster"), logical(1)))) {
  degs_by_mode$custom_cluster <- load_DEGs(repo_root = repo_root, mode = "custom_cluster")
}

scz_gwas <- loadGWAS("SCZD", 1e-6, repo_root = repo_root)
missing_gwas_cols <- setdiff(c("variant_id", "p"), names(scz_gwas))
if (length(missing_gwas_cols) > 0) {
  stop("Missing required SCZ GWAS columns: ", paste(missing_gwas_cols, collapse = ", "))
}

gwas_set <- unique(scz_gwas[p < 5e-8 & !is.na(variant_id), variant_id])
gwas1e6_set <- unique(scz_gwas[!is.na(variant_id), variant_id])

analysis_manifests <- lapply(
  analysis_configs,
  function(config) load_eqtl_manifest(
    tqtl_in_dir = config$tqtl_in_dir,
    context_order = config$context_order,
    split_order = config$split_order
  )
)

lapply(analysis_manifests, function(x) x[, .N, by = .(split, covariate_model)])
```

```{r plotting-helpers}
eqtl_barchart <- function(mapsum, indep = FALSE, analysis_label = NULL,
                          context_order = names(SEURAT_CONTEXT_TO_DATASET_ID),
                          split_order = DEG_SPLITS) {
  dt <- copy(mapsum)
  dt[, context := factor(context, levels = context_order)]
  dt[, split := factor(split, levels = split_order)]
  dt[, lab_above := sprintf("GWAS: %d\nDEG: %d\nDEG+GWAS: %d", n_GWAS, n_DEG, n_DEG_GWAS)]
  dt[, y_top := fifelse(n_eGenes > 0, n_eGenes, 0)]

  ytitle <- if (indep) {
    "Total independent cis-eQTL signals"
  } else {
    "eGenes discovered (lead cis-eQTLs, q < 0.05)"
  }
  title <- if (indep) {
    "Independent cis-eQTLs by context and split"
  } else {
    "Lead cis-eQTLs by context and split"
  }
  if (!is.null(analysis_label) && nzchar(analysis_label)) {
    title <- paste0(title, " (", analysis_label, ")")
  }

  ggplot(dt, aes(x = context, y = n_eGenes, fill = context)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.7, color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.2) +
    geom_text(aes(y = y_top, label = n_eGenes), vjust = -0.3,
              fontface = "bold", size = 3.1, color = "black") +
    geom_text(aes(y = y_top, label = lab_above), vjust = -1.3,
              color = "black", size = 2.6, lineheight = 0.9) +
    facet_wrap(~ split, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.32))) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = ytitle, title = title) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "none",
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95", color = "grey80")
    )
}

deg_view_barchart <- function(view_summary, title,
                              context_order = names(SEURAT_CONTEXT_TO_DATASET_ID),
                              split_order = DEG_SPLITS) {
  dt <- copy(view_summary)
  dt[, context := factor(context, levels = context_order)]
  dt[, split := factor(split, levels = split_order)]
  dt[, deg_view_label := fifelse(deg_sex == "all", deg_view, paste(deg_view, deg_sex, sep = ": "))]

  ggplot(dt, aes(x = context, y = n_eGene_DEG_overlap, fill = context)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.7, color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.2) +
    geom_text(aes(label = n_eGene_DEG_overlap), vjust = -0.25, size = 2.5) +
    facet_grid(deg_view_label ~ split, scales = "free_y") +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.20))) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "eGene-DEG overlaps", title = title) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "none",
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95", color = "grey80")
    )
}

broad_eqtl_count_barchart <- function(mapsum, view_summary, deg_view, title, ytitle,
                                      context_order, split_order) {
  required_map_cols <- c("context", "split", "n_eGenes")
  required_view_cols <- c("context", "split", "deg_view", "deg_sex", "n_eGene_DEG_overlap")
  missing_map_cols <- setdiff(required_map_cols, names(mapsum))
  missing_view_cols <- setdiff(required_view_cols, names(view_summary))
  if (length(missing_map_cols) > 0) {
    stop("Missing broad plot map columns: ", paste(missing_map_cols, collapse = ", "))
  }
  if (length(missing_view_cols) > 0) {
    stop("Missing broad plot view columns: ", paste(missing_view_cols, collapse = ", "))
  }

  dt <- copy(mapsum[, .(context, split, n_eGenes)])
  target_deg_view <- deg_view
  view_dt <- copy(
    view_summary[deg_view == target_deg_view & deg_sex == "all",
      .(context, split, n_eGene_DEG_overlap)
    ]
  )
  if (nrow(view_dt) == 0) {
    stop("No rows available for DEG view: ", deg_view)
  }

  dt <- merge(dt, view_dt, by = c("context", "split"), all.x = TRUE)
  dt[is.na(n_eGene_DEG_overlap), n_eGene_DEG_overlap := 0L]
  dt[, context := factor(context, levels = context_order)]
  dt[, split := factor(split, levels = split_order)]
  dt <- dt[!is.na(context) & !is.na(split)]
  dt[, lab_overlap := sprintf("DEG: %d", n_eGene_DEG_overlap)]
  max_count <- max(dt$n_eGenes, na.rm = TRUE)
  if (!is.finite(max_count) || max_count <= 0) {
    max_count <- 1
  }
  dt[, y_count := n_eGenes + max_count * 0.025]
  dt[, y_overlap := n_eGenes + max_count * 0.100]

  ## keep split colors stable across Seurat and custom-cluster plots
  split_colors <- c(all = "#4D4D4D", male = "#2B6CB0", female = "#C05621")
  split_colors <- split_colors[intersect(names(split_colors), split_order)]
  dodge <- position_dodge(width = 0.82)

  ggplot(dt, aes(x = context, y = n_eGenes, fill = split)) +
    geom_col(position = dodge, width = 0.72, color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.2) +
    geom_text(
      aes(y = y_count, label = n_eGenes),
      position = dodge, vjust = 0, fontface = "bold", size = 4.0
    ) +
    geom_text(
      aes(y = y_overlap, label = lab_overlap),
      position = dodge, vjust = 0, size = 3.4, color = "black"
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = split_colors, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.38))) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = ytitle, fill = "Split", title = title) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "top",
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95", color = "grey80")
    )
}

summary_path <- function(filename, suffix = "") {
  file.path(summary_dir, add_filename_suffix(filename, suffix))
}

write_analysis_summaries <- function(result, config) {
  suffix <- config$summary_suffix

  for (split_name in names(result$counts_tables)) {
    fwrite(
      result$counts_tables[[split_name]],
      summary_path(paste0("map_independent_counts_", split_name, ".csv"), suffix)
    )
    fwrite(
      result$overlap_tables[[split_name]],
      summary_path(paste0("map_independent_deg_overlap_", split_name, ".csv"), suffix)
    )
  }

  fwrite(result$map_cis_summary, summary_path("map_cis_summary.csv", suffix))
  fwrite(result$map_independent_summary, summary_path("map_independent_summary.csv", suffix))
  fwrite(result$map_cis_deg_view_summary, summary_path("map_cis_deg_view_summary.csv", suffix))
  fwrite(result$map_independent_deg_view_summary, summary_path("map_independent_deg_view_summary.csv", suffix))
  fwrite(result$map_independent_deg_view_overlap, summary_path("map_independent_deg_view_overlap.csv", suffix))

  ggsave(
    filename = summary_path("map_cis_summary_barchart.pdf", suffix),
    plot = eqtl_barchart(
      result$map_cis_summary,
      indep = FALSE,
      analysis_label = config$analysis,
      context_order = config$context_order,
      split_order = config$split_order
    ),
    width = 11,
    height = 12
  )
  ggsave(
    filename = summary_path("map_independent_summary_barchart.pdf", suffix),
    plot = eqtl_barchart(
      result$map_independent_summary,
      indep = TRUE,
      analysis_label = config$analysis,
      context_order = config$context_order,
      split_order = config$split_order
    ),
    width = 11,
    height = 12
  )
  ggsave(
    filename = summary_path("map_cis_deg_view_summary_barchart.pdf", suffix),
    plot = deg_view_barchart(
      result$map_cis_deg_view_summary,
      paste0("map-cis DEG-view overlaps (", config$analysis, ")"),
      context_order = config$context_order,
      split_order = config$split_order
    ),
    width = 14,
    height = 14
  )
  ggsave(
    filename = summary_path("map_independent_deg_view_summary_barchart.pdf", suffix),
    plot = deg_view_barchart(
      result$map_independent_deg_view_summary,
      paste0("independent signal DEG-view overlaps (", config$analysis, ")"),
      context_order = config$context_order,
      split_order = config$split_order
    ),
    width = 14,
    height = 14
  )

  if (identical(config$analysis, "seurat")) {
    ggsave(
      filename = summary_path("map_cis_broad_interaction_grouped_barchart.pdf", suffix),
      plot = broad_eqtl_count_barchart(
        result$map_cis_summary,
        result$map_cis_deg_view_summary,
        deg_view = "broad_interaction",
        title = "Lead cis-eQTLs by Seurat context (broad interaction)",
        ytitle = "eGenes discovered (lead cis-eQTLs, q < 0.05)",
        context_order = config$context_order,
        split_order = config$split_order
      ),
      width = 14,
      height = 7.5
    )
    ggsave(
      filename = summary_path("map_independent_broad_interaction_grouped_barchart.pdf", suffix),
      plot = broad_eqtl_count_barchart(
        result$map_independent_summary,
        result$map_independent_deg_view_summary,
        deg_view = "broad_interaction",
        title = "Independent cis-eQTLs by Seurat context (broad interaction)",
        ytitle = "Total independent cis-eQTL signals",
        context_order = config$context_order,
        split_order = config$split_order
      ),
      width = 14,
      height = 7.5
    )
  }

  if (identical(config$analysis, "custom_cluster")) {
    ggsave(
      filename = summary_path("map_cis_custom_primary_barchart.pdf", suffix),
      plot = broad_eqtl_count_barchart(
        result$map_cis_summary,
        result$map_cis_deg_view_summary,
        deg_view = "custom_primary",
        title = "Lead cis-eQTLs by custom cluster (custom primary)",
        ytitle = "eGenes discovered (lead cis-eQTLs, q < 0.05)",
        context_order = config$context_order,
        split_order = config$split_order
      ),
      width = 14,
      height = 7.5
    )
    ggsave(
      filename = summary_path("map_independent_custom_primary_barchart.pdf", suffix),
      plot = broad_eqtl_count_barchart(
        result$map_independent_summary,
        result$map_independent_deg_view_summary,
        deg_view = "custom_primary",
        title = "Independent cis-eQTLs by custom cluster (custom primary)",
        ytitle = "Total independent cis-eQTL signals",
        context_order = config$context_order,
        split_order = config$split_order
      ),
      width = 14,
      height = 7.5
    )
  }

  for (split_name in names(result$overlap_tables)) {
    preview_dt <- result$overlap_tables[[split_name]][, .(
      dataset_id, context, status, n_independent_signals, n_eGenes,
      n_context_DEGs, n_eGene_DEG_overlap, eGene_DEG_overlap_gene_names
    )]
    fwrite(
      preview_dt,
      summary_path(paste0("map_independent_deg_ovl_", split_name, "_summary.csv"), suffix)
    )
  }

  invisible(TRUE)
}
```

```{r summarize-analyses}
analysis_results <- lapply(names(analysis_configs), function(analysis_name) {
  config <- analysis_configs[[analysis_name]]
  summarize_eqtl_analysis(
    config = config,
    degs = degs_by_mode[[config$deg_mode]],
    g2sym = g2sym,
    gwas_set = gwas_set,
    gwas1e6_set = gwas1e6_set,
    repo_root = repo_root,
    context_order = config$context_order,
    split_order = config$split_order
  )
})
names(analysis_results) <- names(analysis_configs)

lapply(analysis_results, function(x) x$counts_dt)
```

```{r write-summaries}
invisible(Map(write_analysis_summaries, analysis_results, analysis_configs))

list.files(summary_dir, pattern = "\\.(csv|pdf)$", full.names = FALSE)
```
